how_get_paid.question: How do I get paid?
how_get_paid.answer: We offer direct payment into your designated bank account. We provide flexible payment terms, allowing you to choose the option that suits you best. We offer three different payment terms: same-day payment, 30-day payment, and 45-day payment. The choice of payment term is entirely up to you, based on your preferences and financial needs.

verification_time.question: How long does it take to verify my account?
verification_time.answer: Typically, the process takes approximately 5-7 working days to complete. After successfully signing up, you can expect to receive an email notification.

required_documents.question: What documents do I need to sign up?
required_documents.answer: Driving Licence: A valid driving licence is essential if you plan to work as a driver or operate a vehicle as part of your activities. Make sure your licence is up-to-date and meets the necessary criteria for the type of vehicle you intend to use. Courier Insurance: If you're working as a courier, it's important to have courier insurance. This type of insurance typically covers you for any potential damage or loss to the items you're transporting. It provides protection for both you and your clients. Liability Insurance: Liability insurance is crucial for protecting yourself and your business against potential claims or lawsuits. It covers damages or injuries caused to others during the course of your work. It's recommended to have liability insurance to mitigate any financial risks. UK Bank Account: Having a UK bank account is often required for various reasons, such as receiving payments, managing finances, and ensuring smooth transactions with clients or employers. It's essential to have a valid bank account that allows you to conduct business transactions efficiently. Smartphone: In today's digital age, a smartphone is an essential tool for many professions, including Couriers. A smartphone enables you to stay connected, access necessary apps, communicate with clients, navigate routes, and manage your work efficiently. Make sure you have a smartphone with internet connectivity and relevant apps for your line of work.

restricted_accounts.question: Why are some accounts restricted?
restricted_accounts.answer: At our company, we value feedback from our customers immensely. In order to maintain the highest standards of service and ensure customer satisfaction, we may impose restrictions on certain accounts based on a history of negative feedback. These restrictions are put in place to address any issues and improve the overall quality of our services.

missed_job.question: What happens if I accept a job but fail to attend as agreed?
missed_job.answer: We take punctuality and reliability seriously, and it is important for us to maintain a high level of professionalism. If you accept a job but do not attend as agreed upon, a penalty may be imposed. This penalty serves as a reminder to honor your commitments and prioritize meeting the expectations of our customers.

contact_team.question: How can I contact a member of your team?
contact_team.answer: We are always here to assist you. If you have any questions, concerns, or require assistance, please don't hesitate to get in touch with our dedicated team. You can reach us at 02035351953. Our team will be happy to provide you with the necessary support and guidance.

how_get_paid.question: How do I pay for services?
how_get_paid.answer: You can pay for services using various payment methods including credit/debit cards, bank transfers, or digital wallets. Payment is typically processed securely through our platform when you place an order or book a service.

verification_time.question: How long does it take to verify my account?
verification_time.answer: Account verification typically takes approximately 5-7 working days to complete. After successfully signing up, you can expect to receive an email notification once your account has been verified.

required_documents.question: What information do I need to create an account?
required_documents.answer: To create an account, you'll need to provide basic information such as your name, email address, phone number, and address. You may also need to verify your identity depending on the services you wish to use. All information is kept secure and confidential.

restricted_accounts.question: Why might my account be restricted?
restricted_accounts.answer: Accounts may be restricted if there are issues with payment, violations of our terms of service, or concerns raised by service providers. If your account is restricted, you'll receive a notification explaining the reason and steps to resolve the issue.

missed_job.question: What happens if I need to cancel an order?
missed_job.answer: You can cancel an order through your dashboard, but cancellation policies may vary depending on the service type and timing. Some services may have cancellation fees if cancelled close to the scheduled time. Check the specific terms when placing your order.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.section_1_content: By accessing and using Swipped, you accept and agree to be bound by the terms and provision of this agreement. If you do not agree to abide by the above, please do not use this service.
terms.section_2_content: Swipped is a platform that connects customers with service providers for various tasks including delivery, cleaning, locksmith services, and more. We act as an intermediary and are not directly responsible for the quality of services provided by third-party providers.
terms.section_3_content: Users are responsible for providing accurate information, treating service providers with respect, and ensuring safe working conditions. Payment must be made as agreed upon booking confirmation.
terms.section_4_content: Service providers must maintain professional standards, arrive on time, complete services as described, and maintain appropriate insurance and licenses where required.
terms.section_5_content: All payments are processed securely through our platform. Prices are clearly displayed before booking confirmation. Refunds are subject to our refund policy and must be requested within the specified timeframe.
terms.section_6_content: Swipped's liability is limited to the extent permitted by law. We are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of our platform or services provided by third parties.
terms.section_7_content: We reserve the right to terminate or suspend access to our service immediately, without prior notice or liability, for any reason whatsoever, including without limitation if you breach the Terms.
terms.section_8_content: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Users will be notified of significant changes via email or platform notifications. Continued use of the service constitutes acceptance of modified terms.
terms.contact_info: For questions about these terms, please contact us at legal@swipped.com

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section_1_content: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, book a service, or contact us. This includes your name, email address, phone number, and payment information.
privacy.section_2_content: We use the information we collect to provide, maintain, and improve our services, process transactions, send you technical notices and support messages, and communicate with you about services and promotional offers.
privacy.section_3_content: We may share your information with service providers who perform services on our behalf, such as payment processing and customer support. We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties.
privacy.section_4_content: We take reasonable measures to help protect your personal information from loss, theft, misuse, and unauthorized access. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.
privacy.section_5_content: We retain your information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide you services. We may also retain and use your information as necessary to comply with our legal obligations.
privacy.section_6_content: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal information. You may also opt out of certain communications from us. Contact us to exercise these rights.
privacy.section_7_content: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to track activity on our service and hold certain information. You can instruct your browser to refuse all cookies or to indicate when a cookie is being sent.
privacy.section_8_content: Our service may contain links to third-party websites or services. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of these third parties. We encourage you to read their privacy policies.
privacy.section_9_content: We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the effective date.
privacy.contact_info: For questions about this privacy policy, please contact us at privacy@swipped.com

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Your trusted partner for essential services across the UK
about.section_1_content: Swipped is a leading service platform connecting customers with trusted service providers across the United Kingdom. We specialize in making essential services—from delivery and cleaning to locksmith services and more—accessible, convenient, and reliable. Our mission is to simplify your life by providing fast, professional services at your doorstep.
about.section_2_content: At Swipped, we believe that getting help when you need it should be simple, fast, and stress-free. Whether you need a delivery, professional cleaning, locksmith services, or any other essential service, we're here to connect you with vetted, reliable professionals who can assist you within minutes. Our goal is to make every service convenient, efficient, and effortless—helping you resolve issues quickly and reliably.
about.section_3_content: Swipped offers a comprehensive range of services including moving and delivery, professional cleaning, locksmith services, car key replacement, Breakdown Assistances, click & collect delivery, and rubbish removals. Our platform connects you with qualified service providers who are ready to help at a moment's notice, typically within 20-60 minutes of your booking.
about.section_4_content: We pride ourselves on reliability, speed, and quality. All our service providers are vetted and verified to ensure they meet our high standards. With Swipped, you can book services in minutes, track your service in real-time, and have peace of mind knowing that professionals are on their way. We also offer competitive pricing and transparent payment processing, so you always know what you're paying for.
about.section_5_content: Customer satisfaction is at the heart of everything we do. We're committed to providing exceptional service, maintaining the highest standards of professionalism, and continuously improving our platform to better serve you. Your trust and satisfaction are our top priorities, and we work tirelessly to ensure every interaction with Swipped exceeds your expectations.
about.contact_info: For more information or inquiries, please contact us at swipped@customerservice.com or call us at 02074867727

howItWorks.label: How It Works
howItWorks.description:
1. Get Your Quote in 60 Seconds
Enter your location and answer a few quick questions about your request. We'll instantly generate the right quote tailored to your needs.

2. Get Matched With a Local Professional
Once your payment is confirmed, we'll connect you to a nearby vetted specialist. You can communicate directly through the in-app calling and messaging system, and track job status, pickup, and arrival times in real-time.

3. Job Completed — Leave a Rating
After the service is finished, leave a review for your service provider to help us maintain quality and improve your experience.
